name: Samhain 2026
theme: The year's end in the old calendar. Hooks for releasing, harvesting and turning toward the dark half of the year.

cards.name: The Release
cards.structure: The thing I'm releasing this season is {old habit}. It gave me {what it gave}, and it cost me {what it cost}.
cards.example: The thing I'm releasing this season is the early client calls. They gave me a full calendar, and they cost me my own morning breath practice.
cards.when_to_pull: You're letting something go and want people to witness it.

cards.name: The Thin Veil
cards.structure: The veil is thin this week, so here is what I rarely say about {topic}: {truth}.
cards.example: The veil is thin this week, so here is what I rarely say about retreats: the hardest hour is the first one, for me too.
cards.when_to_pull: You're ready to share a quieter truth about your work.

cards.name: The Lineage
cards.structure: Before me, {who came before} taught me {lesson}. I carry it into {your work} like this: {how}.
cards.example: Before me, my first teacher taught me to wait for the exhale. I carry it into every retreat like this: nobody speaks until the room has breathed together.
cards.when_to_pull: You want to honour where your way of working comes from.

cards.name: The Harvest
cards.structure: What I gathered this year: {win one}, {win two}, {win three}. What I'm leaving in the field: {what stays behind}.
cards.example: What I gathered this year: a waitlist, a co-teacher, a slower pace. What I'm leaving in the field: the weekend workshops.
cards.when_to_pull: A year-end look back that names wins and endings in one breath.

cards.name: The Lantern
cards.structure: If you're walking into {dark season} feeling {feeling}, here is one small light for {audience}: {practice}.
cards.example: If you're walking into winter feeling flat, here is one small light for tired founders: three slow breaths before you open the laptop.
cards.when_to_pull: Your reader is heading into a hard stretch and needs one kind, usable thing.

cards.name: The Costume
cards.structure: For years I dressed {my work} up as {mask}. Underneath it was {what was true}.
cards.example: For years I dressed my retreats up as wellness holidays. Underneath it was a room where women finally stop performing.
cards.when_to_pull: You're naming what your work really is, under the polite version.

cards.name: The Altar
cards.structure: On my desk this season: {object one}, {object two} and {object three}. Each one is there for {intention}.
cards.example: On my desk this season: a tealight, a shell from the retreat beach and a list of three names. Each one is there for keeping the work small and close.
cards.when_to_pull: A cosy, visual post that shows what you're tending right now.

cards.name: The Turning
cards.structure: Samhain marks the old year's end. My new year starts with {first move} for {audience}, beginning {when}.
cards.example: Samhain marks the old year's end. My new year starts with a winter breath circle for new founders, beginning the first new moon of December.
cards.when_to_pull: You're announcing what comes next and want it to land as a fresh start.
